# Len's Self Storage

> > Secure self-storage units and moving services across Edinburgh and Glasgow with flexible options for personal, business, and student needs.

Len's Self Storage is a family-run business offering storage solutions at four branches (Granton and Sighthill in Edinburgh; Hillington and Kinning Park in Glasgow). The company provides personal and commercial storage units, drive-up containers, removal services, and packing materials with competitive pricing and promotional offers.

## Storage Solutions by Type

- [Personal Storage Units](https://www.lenlothian.com/personal-storage): Personal storage units in Edinburgh and Glasgow with 50% off promotion.
- [Business Storage](https://www.lenlothian.com/business-storage): Commercial business storage solutions across Edinburgh and Glasgow branches.
- [Student Storage](https://www.lenlothian.com/student-storage): Affordable student storage lockers in Edinburgh and Glasgow with discounts.
- [Premium Drive-Up Containers](https://www.lenlothian.com/containers): Premium drive-up containers offering 24-hour self-sufficient storage access.

- [Hillington Branch, Glasgow](https://www.lenlothian.com/store/hillington-branch): Hillington branch: storage units and containers in Glasgow with parking.
- [Kinning Park Branch, Glasgow](https://www.lenlothian.com/store/kinning-park-branch): Kinning Park branch: secure storage units in Glasgow with flexible terms.
